residualRisks: Real completed-run history restoration and the new native TUI history panel were not end-to-end validated in this phase.
The failed diagnostic used a 2s provider-readiness timeout; a separate fresh Host returned its first provider response in about 7.5s. The first failure does not prove the executable cannot start.
GET /provider included an explicitly fake fixture API credential in options. Real credential handling and authenticated/remote exposure require a separate audit.
The prior Build-tools versus Build-Tools test expectation defect remains unchanged and was not included in this selected test run.
Legacy unsigned coordinator snapshots lack the new metadata and are not upgraded into trusted session history.
Per-session serialization is in-process; independent concurrent Hosts and adversarial same-user filesystem access are not solved by HMAC.
No paid/OAuth provider, long-running user workload, Linux/WSL sandbox, packaging, or complete regression proof was obtained.
